subject.title: fix(state): run additive column migration before canonical schema assertion

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` eagerly add selected media-record columns for pre-v2 databases without `audit_events`, or should that intentional normal-open handoff remain unchanged unless a current failure is reproduced?
rationale: Current source documents the no-audit handoff as intentional, while the proposed patch changes it without showing a current failing DDL path.

options.title: Require a current failing baseline
options.body: Keep the handoff unchanged until the contributor demonstrates a current-release legacy database that still fails and patches the DDL boundary that actually causes it.

options.title: Adopt eager doctor completion
options.body: Accept the new doctor contract and require an explicit migration rationale plus upgrade tests covering both no-audit repair and normal open.

recommendation.title: Require a current failing baseline
recommendation.body: Keep the handoff unchanged until the contributor demonstrates a current-release legacy database that still fails and patches the DDL boundary that actually causes it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the current shared-state migration contract; local history provenance for the responsible area owner could not be completed.
